response.sql: WITH media_type_stats AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) as avg_unit_price, AVG(Bytes * 1.0 / Milliseconds) as bytes_per_ms FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), media_type_average AS (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_ms) as avg_bytes_per_ms FROM media_type_stats), filtered_types AS (SELECT mts.avg_unit_price, mts.bytes_per_ms FROM media_type_stats mts CROSS JOIN media_type_average mta WHERE mts.bytes_per_ms > mta.avg_bytes_per_ms) SELECT AVG(avg_unit_price), AVG(bytes_per_ms), AVG(bytes_per_ms) - (SELECT avg_bytes_per_ms FROM media_type_average) FROM filtered_types;
